origin.description: another origin of the lab this point lives on (a loopback origin the app itself hard-codes, e.g. its API's); url stays a path. Default: the lab's base (FR-LAB-308).

account_value.description: the point's value is this value of the run's own account (`fuzzlab auto --identity`): what the lab's bootstrap stored for it (e.g. user_id), which exists only once the account does (FR-LAB-309).

json_body.description: a JSON body the app sends to this endpoint; param names one of its leaves (core.jsonbody naming). The point is then fuzzed as a JSON leaf with the other leaves sent too (FR-FUZZ-54).

client_only.description: true when the param is used only client-side (no server reflection); a server-side crawler cannot see it.
